arms.A_PROMOTED_MATCHING: Same originating rejection; candidate independently adjudicated and promoted to ACTIVE matching constraint.
arms.B_NOT_PROMOTED: Same originating rejection and candidate; independent adjudicator returns HOLD, so constraint remains DORMANT.
arms.C_PLACEBO: Independent promotion occurs, but active placebo constraint targets an unrelated mutation class.
arms.D_ATTRIBUTION_ABLATION: Same originating rejection retained, but causal-attribution mapping is ablated before candidate derivation, producing a non-matching promoted rule.

design.authority_ablation: Generator attempting to adjudicate its own candidate must raise a fail-closed authority separation error.

estimands.fixture_ate_A_minus_B: mean(Y_A-Y_B) across 30 preregistered distinct hazardous fixtures

primary_outcome: Y=1 iff later hazardous mutation final_decision is BLOCK; Y=0 otherwise.
research_question: Does independently adjudicated promotion of a rejection-derived causal constraint change later decisions across a preregistered set of distinct hazardous fixtures under paired identical input/state, beyond baseline governance, placebo policy, and causal-attribution ablation?
success_criteria: paired exact sign/binomial p < 0.05 for A vs B discordances, reported as descriptive fixture-level evidence only
high-confidence negative-control false-block rate = 0 across all 120 arm evaluations
compensating-guard negative-control false-block rate = 0 across all 120 arm evaluations
input_hash and state_hash_before are identical across arms within each fixture
supersession_reason: Methodological correction before implementation/execution: v1.0 repeated one deterministic fixture 30 times, which would create pseudo-replication. v1.1 freezes 30 distinct paired fixtures and treats statistics as fixture-level evidence only.
